name: Dunaszeg (Hungary)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, blue, white and blue in the ratio 3:1:1:1:3, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dunaszeg (a crowned blue and white shield with a black bird and a fleur-de-lis) above a yellow scroll inscribed DUNASZEG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dunaszeg arms with crown and scroll
